about.floor_note: Brand Safety Floor = content no ads should ever fund.
about.suitability_note: Brand Suitability = controlled adjacency to sensitive content at High/Med/Low risk based on brand values.

sources.label: GARM Brand Safety Floor & Suitability Framework (June 2022)

categories.name: Adult & Explicit Sexual Content
categories.tooltip: Includes pornography, explicit sexual acts, fetish content, escorting, or exploitation.

categories.name: Arms & Ammunition
categories.tooltip: Weapons manufacturing, sales, or instruction. Includes illicit firearms trafficking.

categories.name: Crime & Harmful Acts / Human Rights Violations
categories.tooltip: Depicts or encourages violent crime, kidnapping, or human exploitation.

categories.name: Death, Injury or Military Conflict
categories.tooltip: Graphic injury, mass casualty events, executions; includes war reporting context.

categories.name: Online Piracy
categories.tooltip: Illegal streaming, counterfeit distribution, malware download instructions.

categories.name: Hate Speech & Acts of Aggression
categories.tooltip: Dehumanizing language targeting protected groups; hateful symbols or attacks.

categories.name: Obscenity & Profanity / Gory or Shocking
categories.tooltip: Intense profanity, graphic gore, shocking pranks. Consider reclaimed language nuance.

categories.name: Illegal Drugs / Tobacco / Vaping / Alcohol (youth)
categories.tooltip: Promotion or glamorization of illicit drugs or underage substance use.

categories.name: Spam or Harmful Content (malware/phishing)
categories.tooltip: Fraud schemes, phishing, malware distribution, brand impersonation.

categories.name: Terrorism
categories.tooltip: Praise, recruitment, or operational content for extremist organizations.

categories.name: Debated Sensitive Social Issues
categories.tooltip: Polarizing sociopolitical topics (e.g., elections, civil rights, climate policy).

categories.name: Misinformation
categories.tooltip: Verifiably false or misleading claims tied to public harm (health, civic, safety).

risk_tiers.label: Low
risk_tiers.definition: Contextual adjacency acceptable with minimal safeguards.

risk_tiers.label: Medium
risk_tiers.definition: Requires case-by-case review or stricter targeting controls.

risk_tiers.label: High
risk_tiers.definition: Limited tolerance; high likelihood of reputational impact.

about.note: IAB Content Taxonomy provides contextual classification distinct from brand safety decisions.
